verdict.rationale: Lovable explicitly says its generated apps are 'backed by editable code' and supports Git sync so you can clone, edit locally in your IDE, and push changes back, but the evidence pack never describes an in-builder raw code editor/view—edits are mainly driven through chat/Build mode or done externally in a local IDE. A community report even notes copy/paste being disabled on a project, undercutting the idea of free direct code manipulation inside the builder UI.
